reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getScheduledAmount, which resolves missing/number/range to the furthest-from-zero amount and is used by every other server path, but scheduleModel.toExternal re-derives it inline.

duplication.why: The full missing/number/range dispatch and the furthest-from-zero comparison are duplicated from getScheduledAmount, with a different tie-break (> instead of >=).

placement.why: Exposing the field in api-models' scheduleModel is the right layer, but the amount rule itself is placed in the API mapper instead of the shared schedules module that owns it.

scope.why: Only the new field, its type and a test.

maintainability.why: The API's expectedAmount will silently diverge from what Actual posts the next time the rule in getScheduledAmount changes, which is exactly the drift the request wants to stop.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount) from #shared/schedules.

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts expectedAmount ternary re-expresses getScheduledAmount's null/number/range resolution with a changed comparison operator.
